description: This file implements the SetState command handler for a server management component, allowing setting the state of a session server via HTTP requests. It includes functions for converting string states to enum values, and a method to process the request and respond accordingly.

classes.name: SetState
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the 'SetState' command, which sets the session server state based on HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: SetState::SetState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetState handler with references to the service and request objects.

methods.name: SetState::run
methods.description: Executes the command to set the session server state based on request parameters and sends an HTTP response.
